{{Modifier|GradiantDetails=to bottom, #006DF8, #0022FF|TextColor=#BBDDFF|Name=[[True Legacy Mode]]|Details=The version of R:FF before the Restructured Update was released. This modifier does not have [[Section I]], and is more bare-bones. The Shadow Challenge is also forced at D-5000, but it only includes [[SHA-1]], [[SHA-2]], and [[SHA-3]].}}

==Overview==
'''True Legacy Mode''' is a modifier that allows you to play the Original '''Rooms: Found Footage''' like it was right before the Restructured Update. This mode is ''Too'' different main game, 2 big changes though are The [[Shadow Challenge]] now being guaranteed at D-5000, though [[SHA-1]], [[SHA-2]], and [[SHA-3]] being the only threats, and [[Section I]] being inaccessible, due to still being under development at the time.
